versions.changelog: v8: delta (since-last-run) scanning via scripts/delta-scan.sh + watermark/24h bootstrap; phone-first grouped digest; day/night cadence guidance. No change to approval/dry-run/send enforcement or env-only credentials.
Setup: show plain 'export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD=...' example alongside the secret-manager form. No script changes.
Setup: supply GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD per run from a secret manager; do not persist or commit it. No script changes.
Docs polish: tighter summary, concrete Setup (required export GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD), discovery topics. No script changes.
Scripts now use env credentials only (no credential-file reads) and invoke gog from PATH (no GOG_BIN override); retains enforced approval/dry-run/send gates.
Enforce approval, dry-run, and send gates in cleanup-execute.py (fixes security rule T09): no --apply without an approval artifact; no send without --send + sendApproved:true + blockAllSends=false.
Initial release: approval-gated Gmail triage into spam/info/action lanes, built on gog + Telegram approval.
